finalText:
Build is clean — exit 0, "0 errors" instead of aborting.

The two real bugs buried in the noise, both from the bundler bump (`fakepack` 3.11.2 → 4.2.0):

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries` (now `undefined`), so `.toFixed(0)` threw at link time. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the old config loader used to send `false` for an unset flag; the new one sends `undefined`. `isBackoffEnabled` had a strict boolean check that threw on anything but `true`/`false`. Fixed it to treat `undefined` as "disabled" instead of erroring.

The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from the dep bump (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, sync loader hooks, `punycode`, `module.parent`, plus the unused-export/circular-import/legacy-crypto notices) — nothing actionable, and the build now finishes with 0 errors.
